A '''dreamshard''' is a pocket dimension created by a powerful [[Dreaming|Dreamer]] or [[Dreamwalking|dreamwalker]]. It exists between the real world and ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. The creator of a dreamshard has complete control over the contents of the dreamshard and the people that are brought into it. [[Ishamael]] was very fond of dreamshards, using them often.
